notes.title: 🔔“Sounds Good” Update
notes.content:
Thanks to the creative work of our audio partners, we’ve added various interaction sounds to all props in the game, making the gameplay more fun.
Besides that, we’ve also replaced some sound effects with better designs and fixed some bugs.

notes.title: 🍰"More Accessible" Update
notes.content:
We did some work to make the game more accessible:
[list]
[*] Improved character control hints in the tutorial.
[*] Optimized Japanese and Korean localization.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2024.08.30
notes.content: Bug fix: In the Reading mini-game, sometimes the first letter (yellow or red) cannot be flipped.

notes.title: 🤼Dev team play demo with different styles
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest is coming. Exhausting to play all the demos?
Try Exhausted Man. He knows your feelings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281325/435ba400d4ec8187744adecb3bc47b6f0675ada4.jpg[/img]

Demo includes:
[list]
[*] A mysterious character (lying down on the wall)
[*] Yet another exhausting story (told by items)
[*] Missions inspired by everyday life (very challenging)
[/list]

We'll live stream a pre-recorded video with a selection of developers' demo play-throughs to show you some unique (hilarious) play styles.
